module: Small Road Architect alias module: it loads editor/roadArchitect/networkImport and re-exports its importOsmFromFile function under the name importFromFile. It serves as the entry point to import an OpenStreetMap (.osm) file into the Road Architect editor.

importFromFile.desc: Alias of networkImport.importOsmFromFile(filePath, options): imports an .osm file and returns a summary { success, importedRoadCount, skippedRoadCount, warnings, ... }.
